_doc: P14.24: Android bundle (Hermes bytecode) budget in bytes, checked by scripts/bundle-size.mjs in CI. Set 2026-10-16 at the measured size (20,889,901 bytes, with FlashList v2) plus 2%. Lower it when the bundle shrinks; never raise it without a reason in the PR. Raised 2026-10-22 (reviewer): the M6 ordering screens (Ord01–Ord11, PRs #1784–#1787) add 131,639 bytes; new budget = measured 21,439,339 + 1%. Raised 2026-10-26 (reviewer): consultations visit-type cards + filters sheet (owner layout 2026-10-26) take the bundle to a measured 21,655,415 bytes; new budget = measured + 1%. Raised 2026-10-30 (Expo SDK 58, PR #2117; lead asked for the measured amount and nothing more): SDK 58 runtime (Sentry RN 8 with replay/feedback modules, react-native-gesture-handler 3, RN 0.88, expo-router 58, expo-updates in the bundle) takes the bundle to a measured 22,153,391 bytes after RTK Query was bundled once (-67,042 bytes); budget = measured, no margin. Raised 2026-10-30 (reviewer, PR #2140): Expo SDK 58 (RN 0.88) with the app features merged after #2117 (#2130 insurance-card delete, #2107 mint-only greens, #2127 app language fallback with LocalizedField/localizedField.ts/rowField.ts and the screen conversions) takes the bundle to the CI-measured 22,191,694 bytes at #2140's head; budget = 22,191,694 + 1% = 22,413,611. Measured by building each merge: #2117 merged = 22,175,971, #2130 +2,013, #2107 +16, #2127 +13,609 (local figures run 77 bytes above CI).
